source.quote: SMSL's own page for the D-6S, read 2026-11-24: « ES9039Q2M Support MQA and MQA-CD »; « The brand-new third-generation XMOS XU-316, supports PCM 32bit/768kHz and DSD512 »; « Input ports (except Bluetooth) support MQA and DSD, coaxial and optical support DoP64 »; « Adapts the latest Bluetooth chip of Qualcomm, supports LDAC 24bit/96kHz, APTX/HD, SBC and AAC ».

facts.chip: ES9039Q2M (ESS) converting, third-generation XMOS XU-316 as the USB interface, a Qualcomm part for Bluetooth.

_except_bluetooth: « Input ports (except Bluetooth) support MQA and DSD » - the maker excludes one input by name, which is a per-input statement even though it carries no rate.
